findings.text: No forced-colors CSS exists anywhere in the diff (changed paths are only MapView.jsx, its test, index.md; grep of src finds none), so the required 'border: 2px solid CanvasText' style for cluster pills, status rings and popup is absent and untested.

MapView.jsx adds no skeleton, no `contain: strict`, no min-h-[400px] on the map container, no animate-pulse degrade and no Retry Map Load fallback; the container still uses the old height style. No test covers containment or CLS.

findings.ac: AC3 / Stress Matrix #4: markers tabindex=-1, Tab exits map
findings.text: Markers are created with L.marker(..., {icon, _company}) without `keyboard: false` or any tabindex=-1, so Leaflet's default makes every pin a tab stop (the trap the AC forbids). The test never asserts marker tabindex or that Tab leaves the map.

The 'renders skip links...' test fires keyDown ArrowRight/ArrowLeft on the region but asserts nothing (comment: 'should not throw'). handleMapKeyDown focus cycling, wraparound, spiderfy, openPopup and Escape->blur are all unverified; the mocked getElement returns a fresh detached element each call, so activeElement matching can never hold.

findings.ac: AC2: clicking/tapping any pin opens popup card linking to company profile (DoD 3)
findings.text: Tests only inspect the bindPopup HTML string (name, '3 Open Roles', 'View Detail →', onclick substring). No test opens the popup, and none verifies that window.__s(slug,'home') calls onSel with the right slug (the link to /{region}/company/{slug}). The sector pill and the singular 'Role' branch are not asserted.

findings.ac: Story 4: count pills colored by dominant hiring status
findings.text: The iconCreateFunction test only checks the count text and the static class 'rounded-full bg-surface border border-accent'. The hiring-dominant vs non-dominant ringClass branch (isHiringDominant, hiringCount >= totalSampled/2) is never asserted, and there is no non-hiring-dominant case.

findings.ac: Story 5: status rings lime for hiring, forest teal for inactive
findings.text: Only the hiring ring (oklch(0.913_0.183_119.7)) is asserted for Sunfire. The inactive branch uses 'border-border/80 shadow-sm', not forest teal as specified, and the Invenox marker (0 jobs) is never checked. The website-derived google favicon URL and the onerror fallback to the sector icon are untested.

findings.ac: AC1: markers cluster on zoom out, logos appear on zoom in, no main-thread freeze (Long Tasks < 50ms)
findings.text: Only the markerClusterGroup constructor options are verified against a mock. Breakout and zoom behavior is not exercised, and no chunkedLoading option or performance check backs the Long Tasks < 50ms criterion (watch; partly unverifiable in jsdom).

findings.ac: Interface Stress Matrix #4: Enter/Space activates marker, Escape exits
findings.text: The aria-label promises 'Enter to select', but handleMapKeyDown only handles arrows and Escape; there is no Enter/Space handling and no activeCompanyId / aria-current sync with the card list. Escape->blur is untested.

findings.ac: Accessibility: skip-links before and after map
findings.text: Only one skip link ('Skip over Interactive Map') is rendered, placed before the map, and the test checks text only. The spec calls for skip links both before and after #directory-map, and the id '#directory-map' is not added by this slice.
